# Test images for the text check

The previews `test/unit/textcheck.test.js` runs `web/js/textcheck.js` on: each is what the
phone hands the app for choosing (the longest side 480 pixels, JPEG 0.7). The name says
what the game must do with it under "Which photos: Little text": `keep-…` stays in the
game, `skip-…` is left out as full of text.

**Drawn** (screens of chats, emails, articles, lists, a document and code, light and dark;
and, to keep, a meme, a story with a sticker, a game and a photo viewer) by
`scripts/helpers/text-fixtures.mjs`. The names, messages and amounts in them are made up.
